reports.biz: Handmade Metal Birdhouse Garden Stakes by Jordan Maynard
reports.desc: There was a web site on ******** about a disabled veteran who was trying to earn money by making the metal birdhouses with garden stakes.  The birdhouses looked nice in the picture so i thought i could help him out by buying 5 for Christmas presents..  This was in July of 2026.  Used a credit card to pay $123.47.   Received an email thanking me for my order with an order number.   Looked good .   But as of this date 9-10-26 no birdhouses have been received.  Today I started checking to see what happened to my   order.   Found out this is a scam.  The name he used was Jordan Maynard.  If was hurt is the war I am sorry for that.  But this is not the way a Christian man/veratrin should be acting.
